changeRequestSent: Change request sent. The OGS will review it.
invalidDescription: The link has expired or is invalid. Please check the URL from your confirmation email or contact the OGS.
loadFallback: The status could not be loaded.
renewalConfirmedOne: Enrollment confirmed. The school administration will review it.
renewalConfirmedMany: {count} enrollments confirmed. The school administration will review them.
withdrawModalTitleChild: Withdraw the enrollment for this child?
withdrawModalBodyChild: If you continue, the enrollment for this child will be withdrawn and no longer processed. You cannot undo this step yourself. In that case, please contact the OGS directly.
withdrawModalBodyAll: If you continue, the enrollment will be withdrawn for all children and no longer processed. You cannot undo this step yourself. In that case, please contact the OGS directly.
submittedTitle: Thank you. Your enrollment has been submitted.
submittedDescription: The OGS reviews your information. You can see the current status on this page. Save the link or keep the confirmation email.
duplicateWarning: At least one child may already have an active enrollment in this phase. The new enrollment was saved anyway. Contact the OGS if you have questions.
statusDescription: Your enrollment was received on {date}. Here you can see the current status, your contact details and the enrolled children.
stepOneSubmitted: The OGS can see your enrollment in administration.
stepOneStatus: The OGS has received the enrollment.
stepTwo: If there are questions, the OGS will contact you by the email address provided.
stepThree: As soon as a decision is made, you will see it under “Children” and receive an email.
renewalRequiredText: We have prepared your enrollment for the next period. Please actively confirm it so your child can take part. Without confirmation, the enrollment expires at the deadline.
autoRenewedText: Your enrollment for the next period was carried over automatically. You do not need to do anything. If you do not want to participate, please unsubscribe by the deadline.
childApprovedText: This enrollment has already been confirmed.
childPendingText: No final decision has been made yet.
childLockedText: This enrollment can no longer be changed online.
changeRequestDescription: This enrollment has already been reviewed. Your changes will therefore be sent to the OGS as a request and applied only after approval.
changeRequestSaveError: The change request could not be saved
changeRequestsDescription: Here you can see requests that are still being reviewed, questions from the OGS and completed decisions.
emailImmutable: The email address cannot be changed here. Please contact the OGS directly.
editLocked: Changes are only possible while no decision has been made yet. Please contact the OGS for changes.
editLockedWithChangeRequest: Direct edits are no longer possible. You can send a change request to the OGS instead.
withdrawText: You can withdraw the enrollment while no decision has been made yet. Already confirmed children remain unchanged. Please contact the OGS directly for that.
renewalAdjustHint: You can continue care unchanged, adjust only offerings or weekdays, or end care at the end of the current period. All other data stays unchanged.
adjustDescription: Adjust only the care offerings and booked weekdays. All other data stays unchanged and is not requested again.
lockedChildHint: Changes for this child go through the parents app.
lockedAllTitle: Changes go through the parents app
lockedAllBodyOne: Your child is already in care. Please make changes in the parents app.
lockedAllBodyMany: Your children are already in care. Please make changes in the parents app.
noAccountTitle: No access to the parents app yet
noAccountIntro: You get access with an invitation by email:
noAccountStepPassword: Set a password. Then you can log in to the parents app.
noAccountHelp: Can’t find the email? Please check your spam folder too. Email missing or the link no longer works? Please contact the OGS.
unavailableAccountHelp: Please contact the OGS. The OGS can help you.
noAccessFallback: No access yet? Open the email “Einladung zum Eltern-Portal”. No email? Please contact the OGS.
signatureDrawn: Drawn with finger, pen or mouse.
signatureChanged: Warning: the stored proof was changed afterwards. Please contact the after-school care.
signatureEditHint: If you change the enrollment, you sign it again.
